Telehealth.HHS.gov
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)
Function:
Wearable arm sensors (such as
Abbott FreeStyle Libre
) track interstitial fluid sugar levels 24/7.
Usage:
Sends real-time alerts for high or low blood sugar without requiring routine finger pricks.
NetMeds Healthcare
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG
Function:
Wrist devices (like
Withings ScanWatch
or Apple Watch) feature PPG and 1-lead ECG sensors.
Usage:
Monitors heart rate variability (HRV), blood oxygen (SpO2), and flags irregular rhythms like atrial fibrillation.
Medanta
Sleep Trackers & Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
Function:
Rings, bands, or patches record sleep architecture, skin temperature, and breathing patterns.
Usage:
Data syncs to clinical platforms allowing medical teams to execute remote patient monitoring for chronic disease management.
